query: What stopping rules and explicit exclusion criteria (with operational thresholds) will we preregister to prevent analytic flexibility?

response.query: What stopping rules and explicit exclusion criteria (with operational thresholds) will we preregister to prevent analytic flexibility?
response.answer: Preregister stopping rules include a maximum of 100 data points and explicit exclusion of outliers beyond 3 standard deviations. Operational thresholds for exclusion are set at p < 0.05 for statistical significance.
